title: Eagles and Jaguars wild start in London: Two players ejected, 90-yard TD nullified after penalties

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles and Jaguars wild start in London: Two players ejected, 90-yard TD nullified after penalties
sources.description: A 90-yard touchdown return by Josh Cameron was wiped out at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium as Bryan Thomas Jr. and Jeremiah Trotter Jr. were both disqualified after a wild sequence
